definitions.explanation: A vast body of salt water, one of the major divisions of the world's oceans.

examples.japanese: {大洋|たいよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大洋|たいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are five oceans in the world.

examples.japanese: {大洋|たいよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧。
examples.english: We encountered a storm in the middle of the ocean.

notes:
{大洋|たいよう} refers specifically to the great oceans of the world — the largest bodies of water. It is more formal and specific than ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧.

THE FIVE OCEANS:
- ⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧: Pacific Ocean
- ⟦{大西洋|たいせいよう}→大西洋：16346_taiseiyou⟧: Atlantic Ocean
- ⟦{インド洋|いんどよう}→インド洋：16610_indoyou⟧: Indian Ocean
- {北極海|ほっきょくかい}: Arctic Ocean
- {南極海|なんきょくかい}: Southern/Antarctic Ocean

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧: sea, ocean (everyday, general)
- ⟦{海洋|かいよう}→海洋：00143_kaiyou⟧: ocean (scientific, formal, often in compounds)
- ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧: ocean (used in compound names like ⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧)

USAGE:
Homophone with ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧ (sun). Context usually makes the meaning clear, but be aware of the distinction in listening.
